verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents directing Copilot in natural language to explore repositories and open pull requests. It also lets users start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks and refine an agent-produced PR through comments. Edits and commits therefore happen indirectly through agent-created PRs. Conversational control of explicit search, commit, pull, and push operations is not documented, and community feedback notes the app is not really a git client. missing for 10: explicit conversational commit/pull/push control, agent-driven search, hands-on corroboration of agent editing from mobile.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can direct an AI agent to browse, search, edit, commit, pull, and push in a repository via conversation

citations.quote: guide you through unfamiliar codebases, provide insights into both public and your private repositories, and open a new pull request – all in natural language
Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile.
Agent Tasks are now on GitHub Mobile, giving developers a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks wherever they are.
